Case Title: Jacob Imanual Shivapur vs The State Of Karnataka

Court: Karnataka High Court, Dharwad Bench | Date: 2021-12-20 | Region: Karnataka | Judge: Justice Shivashankar Amarannavar

Bail Type: Regular | Outcome: Granted (Regular bail granted as the accused was caught preparing for dacoity, but had no prior criminal record and was similarly placed to co-accused already granted bail.)

Statutes / IPC Sections Invoked: Section 399 IPC, Section 402 IPC

Facts:
On 15 November 2021, police received information about five suspicious persons at Mahadwar Road, Belagavi. They were apprehended with weapons including a knife, jambe, chilli powder, and monkey caps. The accused, including Jacob Imanual Shivapur, admitted they were preparing to commit robbery or dacoity. Jacob was arrested and remained in custody, with no prior criminal antecedents.

Judgment Reasoning:
The court noted that the accused was in custody since 15.11.2021, had no criminal antecedents, and was similarly placed to co-accused already granted bail. Bail was granted with conditions to prevent interference with the investigation.

Summary:
Karnataka High Court granted bail to Jacob Imanual Shivapur in a dacoity preparation case, noting absence of prior criminal record and parity with co-accused.
